explanation: Tens of thousands of Indigenous allies, above all Tlaxcalans who resented Aztec rule, fought beside a much smaller Spanish force.

claims.text: Hernán Cortés and his Indigenous allies overthrew the Aztec Empire in 1521.
The Inca, the Maya and the Olmecs were not overthrown by Cortés in 1521.
Tens of thousands of Indigenous allies, especially Tlaxcalans, fought alongside Cortés's much smaller Spanish force.
The Tlaxcalans were enemies of the Aztecs.
